description: Browse live games. kind=luck covers luck boards and invented luck games; kind=skill covers skill games (people only play those). Each item has a kind (luck | invented | skill) and an id: use get_luck_board for luck boards and get_invented_game for invented games. Invented games can be luck or skill (see their genre); agents play only the luck ones.
